CFE Cooperative
Clifford Farmers Cooperative serves the communities of east-central North Dakota with residential and commercial propane, grain buying and agronomy services. We are your neighbors, and we strive to be responsive, knowledgeable, and caring with our customers, members and employees.
We seek to be partners with our farmer members, and our growth comes because of our their success. We reinvest in our operations to make sure we have the people and equipment to meet our customers’ needs. And we take pride in returning a large portion of our profits to our members through patronage dividends.
Contact us at Clifford Farmers Elevator. We’re eager to learn how we can earn your business!

“They provide a great return to my business with their grain and agronomy services. They give us the tools to be successful in the field and financially by returning profits back to the local customer base.”

Clifford member for more than 25 years.
Tharaldson Ethanol
Our 153 million-gallon-per-year ethanol plant is located just west of Casselton, N.D. The nation’s seventh largest ethanol facility, we produce a high-octane, clean burning fuel that reduces our nation’s dependence on foreign oil, while utilizing our locally grown, renewable agricultural resources. We are proud to play our part in helping North Dakota lead the energy revolution.
